assignment: Enumerate every live Object(NonMatching, ...) registration, identify units whose fresh objdiff fuzzy_match_percent is 100.0, and reclaim only already-proven exact matches; match no new functions

method.registration_parser: Python AST over live Object calls: first positional argument must be the NonMatching name and second positional argument must be a constant string; this includes multiline calls and excludes comments
method.join_key: configure.py object path to objdiff metadata.source_path after removing the src/ prefix
method.reclaim_gate: A prefiltered candidate may be changed to Matching only when fresh section-level objdiff evidence proves all retail code and data sections exact, including relocations and generated section ownership and size, followed by the exact-link and retail-DOL SHA-1 gates

outcome: No live NonMatching registration has aggregate fuzzy_match_percent 100.0 in the fresh report. No registration or source was changed, no bytes were reclaimed, and no new function was matched.

matched_byte_accounting.terminology: Matched measures are objdiff report byte measures. Complete measures and unit counts are included separately because they are not interchangeable with matched-byte accounting or configure.py registration counts.
